verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for any online service holding user data, including a tax portal, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no documented user-facing retention settings or data-deletion capability. Agents adding or deleting client enrollments (fl-dor-docs-3, fl-dor-docs-11) and emailing to reverse an E-Verify certification (fl-dor-docs-7) are adjacent account-management features, not control over data retention or deletion.
